name: Foundational technology

subjectOf.text: Blockchain is not a disruptive technology but a foundational technology, and its transformational impact therefore takes decades rather than years.
subjectOf.abstract: blockchain technology is not a disruptive technology, it is a foundational technology whose transformational impact takes decades rather than years
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain Solutions for Agency Problems in Corporate Governance (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3373393

subjectOf.text: Because blockchain is a foundational technology, blockchain-based governance solutions for agency problems depend on the creation of infrastructure components that have not yet been conceptualized in the decentralized technology evolution.
subjectOf.abstract: blockchain- based governance solutions for agency problems in corporate governance depend on the creation of infrastructure components that have not yet been conceptualized in the decentralized technology
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain Solutions for Agency Problems in Corporate Governance (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3373393

subjectOf.text: Decentralized infrastructure is interdependent across layers, so even a fully developed and instantiated infrastructure product in one area may collapse without supporting decentralized infrastructure products in other, inevitably related areas.
subjectOf.abstract: Even a fully developed and instantiated infrastructure product in one area may collapse without the supporting structures build by decentralized infrastructure products in other, yet inevitably related, areas.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralization Neutralizers (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3808873
scope_conditions: complex decentralized systems with multiple underdeveloped infrastructure layers
